directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write a letter to express your thanks to your parents or any family members upon making memorable achievement. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Dear Mom and Dad,

I am writing this letter to express my heartfelt gratitude to you for your unwavering support and love, which have been the driving force behind my recent academic success.

To begin with, your constant encouragement has given me the confidence to face challenges head-on. When I was struggling with difficult courses, you always believed in me and told me that I could overcome any obstacle. For example, during the preparation for the final exams, your words of comfort and motivation helped me stay focused.

In addition, you have provided me with a stable and warm family environment. After a long-day study, coming back home to your loving smiles and delicious meals has always been a great relief. This kind of support has allowed me to fully concentrate on my studies.

Furthermore, you have set a good example for me with your hard-working and responsible attitude. Your dedication to your work has inspired me to be more committed to my studies.

In conclusion, I am truly grateful for everything you have done for me. I will continue to work hard and make you proud.

Yours sincerely,
[Your Name]
